title: 第8章【冥婚】即合理又不合理的东西
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一声巨响，斧头重重的披在了棺材身上，顿时一道恐怖的裂痕出现在棺身上。

紧接着，又是第二下第三下，一连十多下将两副棺材劈成碎片，散落一地。

很快，雾气退出客厅，接着开始消散，而顾原的五感也在迅速恢复着。

看着眼前的一切，顾原露出一个兴奋的笑容，果然自己没有猜错，因为马家马天死了，并且抢来了方清的尸体，所以有棺材很正常。

而因为棺材却正好摆在客厅，所以显得又有些不合理。

而这两个条件刚好构成了张晓所说的即合理又不合理。

只不过自己最后才猜到。

外面的雾气也完全消散，露出原本的面目。

张晓此刻坐在地上，背靠着一块无字石碑，身上满是鲜血，脸色惨白，看上去情况不妙。

而除他之外，地上还站着十多具尸体，只不过他们的额头上都贴着符纸。

“你还好吧？”顾原走进扶着张晓，后者挤出一个难看的笑容，“你要是再晚一点，我就死这了。”

顾原露出一个尴尬的笑容，随后走到一旁站到那个被自己砍掉胳膊的尸体，从断臂处一看，瞳孔一缩，头皮都有些发麻。

“这......这竟然是纸人！”

“什么？！”

张晓闻言也一惊，拖着受伤的身子一瘸一拐的快速走了过来，低头一看，就从断臂处看到了不可思议的一幕。

在断臂里面，并不是正常人的肉体和骨头，相反，到处都是黄纸和竹篾。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There was a loud noise, and the ax was heavily draped on the coffin, and a terrifying crack suddenly appeared on the coffin.

Immediately afterwards, there was a second and third blow, and more than ten blows in a row split the two coffins into pieces and scattered them on the ground.

Soon, the mist exited the living room and began to dissipate, and Gu Yuan's five senses were also rapidly recovering.

Looking at everything in front of him, Gu Yuan showed an excited smile. Sure enough, he guessed correctly. Because the Ma family's Ma Tian died and Fang Qing's body was snatched away, it was normal to have a coffin.

And because the coffin happened to be placed in the living room, it seemed a bit unreasonable.

These two conditions just constitute what Zhang Xiao said is both reasonable and unreasonable.

It's just that I guessed it in the end.

The fog outside also completely dissipated, revealing its original appearance.

Zhang Xiao was sitting on the ground, leaning against an unmarked stone tablet. His body was covered in blood, his face was pale, and he looked like he was in a bad situation.

Besides him, there were more than ten corpses standing on the ground, but they all had talisman stickers on their foreheads.

"Are you okay?" Gu Yuan walked in and helped Zhang Xiao, who forced out an ugly smile, "If you had been a little later, I would have died."

Gu Yuan showed an embarrassed smile, then walked aside and stood in front of the corpse whose arm he had chopped off. When he looked at the broken arm, his pupils shrank and his scalp felt numb.

"This...this is actually a paper man!"

"What?!"

Zhang Xiao was shocked when he heard this, and limped over quickly dragging his injured body. When he lowered his head, he saw an incredible scene from the broken arm.

Inside the broken arm, there is no normal human flesh and bones. On the contrary, yellow paper and bamboo strips are everywhere.
